events.title: First Crusade begins the siege of Jerusalem
events.description: The crusader armies reached Jerusalem and invested the city. They stormed it on 15 July and massacred many of its Muslim and Jewish inhabitants.
events.html: The crusader armies reached Jerusalem and invested the city. They stormed it on 15 July and massacred many of its Muslim and Jewish inhabitants.

events.title: Spain and Portugal sign the Treaty of Tordesillas
events.description: The two kingdoms divided newly found lands along a meridian 370 leagues west of Cape Verde. The line later gave Portugal its claim to Brazil.
events.html: The two kingdoms divided newly found lands along a meridian 370 leagues west of Cape Verde. The line later gave Portugal its claim to Brazil.

events.title: Earthquake sinks much of Port Royal, Jamaica
events.description: A violent earthquake plunged two-thirds of the buccaneer town into the sea, killing some 2,000 people at once. Many saw it as divine judgement on 'the wickedest city on Earth'.
events.html: A violent earthquake plunged two-thirds of the buccaneer town into the sea, killing some 2,000 people at once. Many saw it as divine judgement on 'the wickedest city on Earth'.

events.title: Richard Henry Lee moves for American independence
events.description: Lee proposed that 'these United Colonies are, and of right ought to be, free and independent States'. Congress adopted the resolution on 2 July.
events.html: Lee proposed that 'these United Colonies are, and of right ought to be, free and independent States'. Congress adopted the resolution on 2 July.

events.title: Norway dissolves its union with Sweden
events.description: The Norwegian parliament declared that King Oscar II had ceased to rule as King of Norway. Sweden accepted the separation peacefully after a referendum, and Norway chose a Danish prince as king.
events.html: The Norwegian parliament declared that King Oscar II had ceased to rule as King of Norway. Sweden accepted the separation peacefully after a referendum, and Norway chose a Danish prince as king.

events.title: Battle of Midway ends with the sinking of Yorktown
events.description: The damaged carrier USS Yorktown finally sank as the battle closed. Japan's loss of four fleet carriers ended its naval superiority in the Pacific.
events.html: The damaged carrier USS Yorktown finally sank as the battle closed. Japan's loss of four fleet carriers ended its naval superiority in the Pacific.
